races.paceDynamic: Bulldog Spirit is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should dictate terms from the start. With prominent runners Mio Amico and The Truant likely to track behind, and three hold-up horses (Polling Day, An Bradan Feasa, Arc Zoosve) starting from the rear, Bulldog Spirit faces no early pressure. The pace will be steady rather than strong over this 2m trip, allowing the leaders to control fractions before the hold-up brigade launch their challenges. This tactical setup strongly favours horses with early pace who can avoid traffic problems and dictate their own terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bulldog Spirit sets steady fractions without pressure from early doors
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows prominent runners to control the race and kick for home before the hold-up horses can mount their usual late charges. Traffic problems in the straight compound issues for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Arc Zoosve hat-trick hero
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: The in-form hat-trick winner gets the perfect setup for his trademark late run and superior class tells. His recent Goodwood success shows he thrives when able to unleash a finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mio Amico takes charge
scenarios.trigger: If Mio Amico moves up to challenge Bulldog Spirit early and takes over
scenarios.body: The progressive four-year-old uses his tactical speed to get first run on his rivals and holds off late challengers. His recent course form gives him a key edge in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from stragglers
scenarios.trigger: If both Polling Day and An Bradan Feasa produce career-best efforts despite layoffs
scenarios.body: The race sets up perfectly for closers when early leaders fold, but both need to overcome significant fitness concerns. Long absences make this scenario require everything to fall into place.

watchPoints.text: Arc Zoosve needs the pace to completely collapse early to unleash his finishing kick - watch for crawling sectionals in the first mile.
Bulldog Spirit showed no pace at Wolverhampton last time and cannot afford another sluggish display when asked to make the running.
An Bradan Feasa faces a 166-day absence that could blunt his finishing kick despite winning last time out in November.
Mio Amico has the tactical pace to move up and challenge early if Bulldog Spirit sets modest fractions.
Both Polling Day and The Truant need significant career-best efforts to overcome superior opposition despite the race shape suiting early pace.

races.paceDynamic: Thestral and Grey Force will set a genuine gallop from the front, with both confirmed leaders likely to dispute the early tempo over this 7f trip. Miss Starlet and Roccobear should press from prominent positions, creating an honest pace that will stretch the field. The strong early gallop should set up a tactical finish where hold-up horses like Lovethiswayagain and Slack Bob can finish strongly from off the pace. This race shape clearly favours closers and hold-up performers who can benefit from the expected strong early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Thestral and Grey Force go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop stretches the field and creates perfect conditions for the closers to finish strongly. Hold-up horses get ideal tempo to aim at in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Contested Lead
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders settles while the other takes charge
scenarios.body: Roccobear and Miss Starlet can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up horses get into gear. Prominent racers get first run on those held up behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are restrained early creating slow fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where early pace position matters most. Front-runners can dictate when to go and kick clear of the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders fold quickly leaving a pace vacuum
scenarios.body: Mid-division horses like those held up can make their moves earlier than expected. The race develops into a messy affair favouring versatile types.

watchPoints.text: Thestral's recent poor form since gelding makes him vulnerable despite leading credentials
Miss Starlet's 167-day absence could leave her short of peak fitness despite early promise
Grey Force and Jack Callan's 3lb claim could prove decisive if getting an uncontested lead
Slack Bob's progressive profile and hold-up style perfectly suits if the pace materializes as expected
Market support for stable debutant Karmacy would signal significant improvement expected

races.paceDynamic: Zatsgood and Special Ghaiyyath both possess natural front-running tendencies and will likely contest the early lead over this 1m trip. With both horses having shown willingness to make the running in previous outings, this creates a genuine pace duel that should establish a solid gallop from the off. The honest pace will stretch the field out and provide the perfect launching pad for closers like Studious, Signcastle City, and Buy The Dip to unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late bursts of speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If both Zatsgood and Special Ghaiyyath go forward aggressively and engage early.
scenarios.body: The contested pace will set up perfectly for the closers to pick off the leaders in the final furlong. Hold-up merchants with proven finishing kicks will have ideal conditions to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Development
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner takes a clear lead while the other settles behind.
scenarios.body: The steadier tempo allows prominent runners to stay closer and time their challenges more effectively. Those positioned just off the pace can sustain longer runs to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Single Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Zatsgood or Special Ghaiyyath gets an uncontested lead while the other is restrained.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates a tactical race where the lone leader can control fractions. Front-runners with stamina reserves can exploit the easier pace to maintain their advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If both potential pace-setters are held up unexpectedly leaving no clear early leader.
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole with positioning crucial. Those drawn well and able to secure racing room will have significant advantages.

watchPoints.text: Special Ghaiyyath and Zatsgood both showing early intent could create a fierce pace battle that sets up the closers perfectly.
Buy The Dip faces a quick turnaround of just 12 days since his recent win and a significant 7lb penalty in stronger company.
Studious wearing cheekpieces for the first time could either enhance his finishing kick or unsettle his usual racing pattern.
Dontspoilasale making stable debut for the Best yard represents an unknown quantity despite solid Irish Polytrack form.
Baltic Voyage racing 1lb below his winning mark but his recent Newbury effort was poor and he may need more time.

runners_data.comment: Faced stiff tasks after starting off last season well; watch market on stable debut/return
runners_data.spotlight: Started off last year in good form for Chris Dwyer including winning a Southwell maiden (7f, Tapeta); regressed afterwards, albeit she faced some stiff tasks; market useful on stable debut (same owners) after seven months off.

runners_data.name: Bella Bisbee
runners_data.note: Prominent type who won over course and distance last month, better drawn than recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Won over C&D last month; better drawn than of late and could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Five wins, four on the AW including over C&D last month; beaten less than a length, albeit only fifth of nine, back here 12 days ago; better drawn than of late and could go well.

runners_data.name: Moonlight Mirage
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making stable debut for David Loughnane, needs pace collapse after poor Southwell return
runners_data.comment: Failed to beat a rival on her stable debut at Southwell last month; enough to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Wolverhampton novice winner (5f, Tapeta) for George Scott last September, but failed to beat a rival on her stable debut/reappearance at Southwell (6f, Tapeta) last month; enough to prove, not least stamina.

runners_data.name: Cloudbuster
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning after 230-day absence, Jack Callan's 3lb claim helps but needs to overcome layoff
runners_data.comment: Mainly consistent last year, but has to overcome a 230-day absence and is drawn widest
runners_data.spotlight: Mainly consistent last year, including a win in a Chepstow maiden (6f, good), and her final effort can be forgiven on account of the draw; has to overcome a 230-day absence, though, and she has the outside stall.

runners_data.name: Bela Sonata
runners_data.note: Front-runner with Oisin Murphy up, needs to bounce back from poor Newcastle return after 116 days off
runners_data.comment: Needs to put a poor performance on her return at Newcastle in January well behind her
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo whose record last year read 131 including a win in a Kempton maiden (7f, Polytrack); needs to put a poor performance on her return at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) in January well behind her, though, and she has been off another four months since.

races.paceDynamic: Barefoot Beach, The Third Star, and Bela Sonata will ensure a strong early gallop, with Handle With Care likely to join them if allowed her head. The presence of five prominent runners (Queue Dos, Inside Story, Brisk Symphony, Bella Bisbee, Cloudbuster) creates serious congestion behind the leaders, particularly dangerous turning for home. Hold-up horses Ghisa, Bami, and Moonlight Mirage will be relying on splits appearing late. This race shape strongly favours the front-runners and those that can secure an early position without traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain their positions through the early pace
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will string out the field and prevent late closers from making up ground, with the winner coming from those who led or raced prominently throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Raid Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the five prominent runners can secure the ideal position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to set up a perfectly-timed challenge from those tracking the leaders, avoiding both early pace pressure and late traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly fierce and the prominent runners get caught up in traffic
scenarios.body: The leaders will come back dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a hold-up horse with a clear run to sweep past tired rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast early and the prominent group gets shuffled back
scenarios.body: A mid-division horse or one that drops out early will inherit the lead and steal the race as others tire or encounter trouble.

watchPoints.text: Barefoot Beach and Handle With Care could clash for the early lead, potentially compromising both front-runners
Inside Story and Brisk Symphony need early position but face serious traffic problems with five prominent runners
Ghisa and Moonlight Mirage require significant pace meltdown to be competitive from their hold-up positions
Queue Dos carries 135lbs which could prove telling if the strong pace develops as expected
The Third Star's 208-day absence makes her pace judgement highly questionable despite leading tendencies

runners_data.name: Penzance
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well below his best form but tongue-tie added suggests connections expect improvement after 39 days off
runners_data.comment: A smart performer in his time, but well below form in last two starts; look elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Has been a smart performer in his time (rated 18lb higher), but well below form in his last two starts including on stable debut here (1m2f) last month; tongue-tie removed after one use; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Epictetus
runners_data.note: Lone leader will control the pace but has never tried this distance and carries a 22-race losing streak into this contest
runners_data.comment: Losing run up to 22 and has never attempted this far before; others safer
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten half a length or less in his last three goes on the AW (7f-9.5f), but losing run up to 22 and has never attempted this far before; others safer.

runners_data.name: Yaa Min
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to his winning course and distance with only a 3lb claim, ideally positioned tactically for this race shape
runners_data.comment: Just 2lb higher than when winning over C&D in March; interesting back here
runners_data.spotlight: Narrowly made a successful stable/handicap debut on his reappearance over C&D in March; twice held over shorter trips since, but interesting back here from just 2lb higher than for his win.

runners_data.name: Twilight Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer seeking hat-trick over course and distance with strong recent form, perfectly suited to expected pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Has won her last two starts over C&D 133 days apart; has to be taken very seriously
runners_data.spotlight: Has won her last two starts over C&D 133 days apart; up another 3lb in her hat-trick bid and she has to be taken very seriously.

runners_data.name: Victors Spirit
runners_data.note: Prominent runner improved since adding hood and drops significantly in class from Southwell win 22 days ago
runners_data.comment: Has improved since handicapping on the AW; should be suited by this return to further
runners_data.spotlight: Has improved since handicapping on the AW with a hood enlisted, beating a solid yardstick at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) last month and finishing second of nine over 1m2f here nine days later; should be suited by the return to further; respected.

runners_data.name: Lightning Tiger
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven stamina at this trip, hood retained, but limited experience on Polytrack compared to other surfaces
runners_data.comment: Has won over this trip on turf; last month's Thirsk reappearance has been franked; hood on
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth in his first two starts on the AW, but has improved since including when making a successful handicap debut at Catterick (1m4f, soft) in October; creditable fourth of 12 on his Thirsk reappearance (1m4f, good) last month (third has won since); could go well in the first-time hood.

runners_data.name: Rogue Impact
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with tendency to fade in finish, making him vulnerable despite recent weight drop of 3lb
runners_data.comment: C&D winner just over a year ago, but his form since then has been patchy; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a C&D maiden just over a year ago, but his form since then has been patchy; down another 3lb, but more needed if he is to resume winning ways.

runners_data.name: Arth's Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse fresh from breakthrough win on Tapeta but poor record on Polytrack surface may count against him
runners_data.comment: Won at Southwell last time, but his record on Polytrack reads 79657 which is a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 14th-time lucky at Southwell (1m4f) a fortnight ago, making his record on Tapeta 5364321; record on Polytrack reads 79657, though, which would be more of a concern than the 6lb rise.

races.paceDynamic: Epictetus is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate a comfortable gallop early, with Penzance, Yaa Min, and Victors Spirit tracking prominently behind him. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Twilight Moon, Lightning Tiger, Rogue Impact, Arth's Gold) will settle at the back, creating a strung-out field. With no pace pressure on Epictetus and the long home straight at Lingfield, this sets up perfectly for the closers to unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained late runs over the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus sets uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady enough for the back-markers to close strongly, with Twilight Moon and Lightning Tiger ideally positioned to strike late. Their stamina and finishing kicks will prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to soften up Epictetus but not fast enough to set up the closers
scenarios.body: Yaa Min or Victors Spirit can capitalize on their prominent positions, having the perfect tactical advantage over both the tiring leader and the hold-up horses who face too much to do. Their mid-race positioning allows them to quicken when it matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus gets very soft fractions and the closers leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left in the tank to resist late challenges, particularly if the hold-up horses get caught in traffic or struggle for room. His recent consistent form on the all-weather gives him the platform to score at this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus goes too slowly and gets challenged early by the prominent racers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with multiple horses hitting the front too soon, setting it up for the strongest stayer to come through. This chaotic pace scenario would particularly suit Lightning Tiger's proven stamina over similar trips.

watchPoints.text: Epictetus could steal this if he gets uncontested soft fractions and the closers are caught napping in the straight
Watch for traffic problems in the home straight with so many hold-up horses needing room to make their runs simultaneously
Twilight Moon's hat-trick bid faces the test of another weight rise and whether she can reproduce her course form
Yaa Min's return to winning course and distance after two below-par efforts over shorter trips could spark revival
Lightning Tiger's inexperience on Polytrack may show despite his proven stamina credentials at this distance
